desc: a guest joins a relay room no one hosts: it asks again after 2 s, then 4, 8, 16 (never every 2 s without end: each try is one of the relay's daily requests), then gives up with the relay's words, for the Start menu's Try again ($TTYD_SYNC_GIVE_UP=20 for the 2 minutes)

log_must: net: the relay: No one is hosting that room
(?s)the next try waits 4 s.*the next try waits 8 s.*the next try waits 16 s
net: the relay said no for 2\d s \(No one is hosting that room\): no more tries until Try again
log_must_not: (?s)no more tries until Try again.*asking the relay again
